An exciting opportunity is presented to work within the Northern Adelaide Local Health Network as a Support Services Attendant within the Forensic Mental Health Division. 

The Support Services Attendant is responsible for a high standard of work, providing a timely, efficient, and effective general service undertaking duties in a range of activity areas as described in this duty statement.

The Support Services Attendant may be required to work within several areas of the Health Service including kitchen, laundry, and housekeeping. Support Services Attendants at this level will have limited experience in the catering industry, however, may apply specific knowledge gained through prescribed training and experience.

About You: 

In this role you will have strong interpersonal and communication skills which will enable you to successfully problem solve, resolve conflicts and negotiate, including the ability to engage in difficult conversations, whilst building and maintaining relationships. An ability to effectively manage multiple, diverse and competing priorities and demonstrated resilience within a stressful and complex environment is essential to this role. 

You will be joining a dynamic and expanding Local Health Network that is committed to delivering contemporary, innovative and high-quality health services within modern facilities. 

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a passionate, highly driven, dedicated and progressive team. 

About Adelaide: 

Adelaide is consistently recognised as a city that artfully combines its compact charm and world-class cuisine with picturesque nature escapes. Ranked one of the worlds "Most Liveable Cities" and "Most Beautiful Cities", Adelaide provides something for everyone combining a wonderful mix of nature with nearby beaches, rolling hills and wildlife and culinary delights with fine dining restaurants, award-winning cafes, bustling food markets and booming boutique bars. Events like the LIV Golf, SANTOS Tour Down Under, Adelaide Fringe and the Adelaide Cabaret Festival add extra appeal to living here. 

About Us: 

The Northern Adelaide Local Health Network (NALHN) is a leading provider of public healthcare services in South Australia, and one of the largest employers in northern Adelaide. 

NALHN serves over 400,000 people in northern Adelaide with a comprehensive range of high-quality healthcare services, including emergency, surgical, obstetric, neonatal, paediatric, oncology, geriatric, palliative care and rehabilitation, and mental health care, as well as primary health care services with a focus on community health promotion and chronic disease management. 

With a commitment for ongoing upgrades to our facilities and the introduction of new services, our priority is delivering exceptional health and wellbeing services that enhance the quality of life for our community. 

With over 7,000 employees, NALHN emphasises quality care and a supportive work environment guided by respect, integrity, and accountability. Our core values foster excellence, innovation, and equitable health outcomes. 

At NALHN Everyone Has a Story, Everyone Matters, Everyone Contributes and Everyone Grows. 

Our Local Health Network Sites and Services: 

NALHN provides a range of hospital (inpatient), outpatient, community and home-based services across multiple sites in Adelaide's north and north-eastern suburbs, including Aboriginal health, mental health, and GP services. 

Lyell McEwin Hospital - the major hospital in northern Adelaide for emergency care, complex and multi-day surgery, medicine, obstetric, paediatrics and outpatient services. 

Modbury Hospital - a general hospital with emergency care, elective surgery, medicine, outpatient and sub-acute services, rehabilitation, geriatric and palliative care. 

Mental Health Services - adult and older persons mental health services and statewide forensic mental health services, across hospital and community settings. 

Watto Purrunna Aboriginal Primary Health Care Services - provides culturally responsive primary healthcare services for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people in-hospital and across four community sites.

AWM OILS PTY LTD Service Stations, a proudly Australian family-owned business operating across Victoria for more than 2 years. The site offers quality fuel, convenience shopping, barista-made coffee, and freshly prepared food. The company is recognised for its friendly customer service, honest fuel pricing, and modern convenience experience. AWM continues to expand its presence by combining fuel services with supermarkets, cafés, and takeaway options to provide customers with a one-stop destination for everyday needs and travel convenience.

About the role
We are seeking an experienced Retail Manager to take full operational ownership of our retail store, team, and supporting operations. This is a genuine management role suited to someone who wants to lead, build, and be accountable for outcomes.

Job Description

Position: Retail Manager

Location of Work: 191-201 High Street, Nagambie, Vic-3608

Employment Type: Permanent, Full time

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation

Duties and Responsibilities

• Oversee the daily operations of the fuel service station, convenience store, and food service areas to ensure efficient business performance and high customer service standards.

• Monitor fuel, grocery, food, and retail stock levels, coordinate ordering activities, and maintain appropriate inventory control procedures to minimise shortages and wastage.

• Supervise, train, and support retail staff, including preparing work rosters, allocating duties, monitoring performance, and ensuring compliance with workplace policies and procedures.

• Develop and implement sales, merchandising, and promotional strategies to maximise revenue, improve customer engagement, and increase store profitability.

• Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety regulations, food safety standards, fuel handling procedures, and company operational policies.

• Resolve customer enquiries, complaints, and service issues professionally to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and repeat business.

• Coordinate store presentation, cleanliness, and maintenance standards to ensure a safe, organised, and welcoming retail environment.

• Liaise with suppliers, service providers, and senior management regarding stock supply, operational requirements, and business performance improvements.

• Analyse sales trends, customer demand, and operational performance data to support decision-making and improve overall store efficiency.

Skills, experience and education required

•	Diploma or higher qualification in Retail Management, Business Administration or related field.
•	Minimum 1 year full-time relevant experience as a Retail Supervisor or Retail Manager.
•	Strong leadership and staff management skills.
•	Inventory and purchasing management experience.
•	Financial and sales reporting capability.
